care.summary: Vibrant variegated trailing philodendron with heart-shaped green and yellow leaves; incredibly easy to grow.
care.light: Bright indirect light for best variegation; tolerates low light
care.water: Keep soil lightly moist; allow top inch to dry between waterings
care.soil: Well-draining potting mix with peat moss and perlite
care.humidity: Moderate to high; tolerates average household humidity
care.fertilizer: Balanced liquid fertilizer monthly during growing season
common_issues: Loss of variegation in low light
tips: Provide a moss pole or trellis for climbing
Wipe leaves to keep them dust-free and shiny
